ai.seo_question: What does it mean when the graves are overturned in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, the 'upturning of graves' (Buthirat) signifies not merely the physical scattering of bodies but the divine dismantling of the barrier between the grave (Barzakh) and the final abode, affirming bodily resurrection (Jasad al-Qiyamah). This event serves as a profound reminder of the transition from the intermediate realm to the eternal accountability, emphasizing that death is not an end but a transition to a new stage of existence.
